name: Arcane Chtonien
description: Nécromancien ranimant les unités perdues lors des combats pour les faire combattre une dernière fois sous la bannière de l'Éveil.

subject.archetype: Arcane Chtonien — Éveil Chthonien Rare obsidienne

loadout.armor_outfit: Formes altérées par l'exposition aux énergies chthoniennes. Peaux pâles translucides avec runes sombres. Yeux entièrement noirs. Ombres détachées.
loadout.arsenal: Equipment designed to channel and amplify the character's decrease ability (enemy_with_highest) — visible energy conduits integrated into the gear

attitude.behavior: Dynamic action pose mid-ability execution — character actively demonstrating their specialty skill — Focused beam of nullification targeting the strongest enemy card

style.rendering_style: gritty_realistic_with_cinematic_OSL, high detail on character features, faction-specific material accuracy

palette_names.name: Deep Void Purple
palette_names.role: primary_accent — energy emanations and shadow auras

palette_names.name: Bone White
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — pale skin and carved runes

palette_names.name: Pitch Black
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — void effects and deepest shadows

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Dramatic rim lighting separating character from background with a focal glow on the primary ability effect

camera.angle: low dramatic angle emphasizing power and heroic stature

scenography.setting: Ancient underground temple with impossible non-Euclidean geometry, walls covered in carved forbidden symbols, massive sealed portal doors radiating dark energy
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Eerie pulsating purple fog along the ground, shadow tendrils detaching and reattaching, pulsating ancient runes glowing intermittently, warped light bending unnaturally, plus targeted suppression — beam locking onto highest-value enemy and reducing their power visible in the environment

card_metadata.description: Nécromancien ranimant les unités perdues lors des combats pour les faire combattre une dernière fois sous la bannière de l'Éveil.
card_metadata.faction_lore: L'Éveil Chthonien est la résurgence d'entités anciennes dormant depuis avant la naissance des étoiles. Leurs cultes rouvrent les portes des plans inférieurs.
card_metadata.frame_detail: Cobalt steel frame with etched faction symbols deeply engraved on each corner of the border
card_metadata.composition_directive: Low angle heroic full-body shot emphasizing power, with ability visualization clearly shown in action
card_metadata.seed_note: For reproducibility: maintain exact faction color palette, frame style by rarity, and ability visualization as described
